question: Who described the algae Spirogyra in 1674 and named the motile organisms Animalcules, meaning ‘little animals’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anton Van Leeuwenhoek**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anton Van Leeuwenhoek** described the algae Spirogyra in 1674.
 
• He named the motile organisms he observed **Animalcules**, meaning 'little animals'.
 
• Leeuwenhoek is often referred to as the **father of microbiology**.
 
• His observations were among the first descriptions of the microbial world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anton Van Leeuwenhoek** was a Dutch scientist and tradesman.
 
• He is best known for his work on the improvement of the microscope and for his contributions towards the establishment of microbiology.
 
• Leeuwenhoek's discovery of microorganisms was a significant milestone in the field of science.
 
• His meticulous observations and documentation laid the groundwork for future research in microbiology and cell biology.
